test_cases:
case_name = 'normal: challenge order parameter'
assert np.allclose(order_parameter(), target)

case_name = 'boundary: minimum allowed dimension'
assert np.allclose(order_parameter(d=10, ell=0), target)

case_name = 'edge: high dimension and angular number'
assert np.allclose(order_parameter(d=400, ell=10), target)

case_name = 'normal: challenge interface basis'
assert np.allclose(mode_basis_at_match(), target)

case_name = 'boundary: minimum dimension with complex frequency'
assert np.allclose(mode_basis_at_match(d=10, ell=0, z=2.0 + 1.0j), target)

case_name = 'edge: high-dimensional basis evaluation'
assert np.allclose(mode_basis_at_match(d=400, ell=2, z=195.0 + 10.0j), target)

case_name = 'normal: compatibility residual near target branch'
assert np.allclose(matching_residual(), target)

case_name = 'boundary: low-dimensional valid residual'
assert np.allclose(matching_residual(d=10, ell=0, z=2.0 + 1.0j), target)

case_name = 'edge: large-d residual evaluation'
assert np.allclose(matching_residual(d=400, ell=2, z=195.0 + 10.0j), target)

case_name = 'normal: d=250 continuation predictor'
assert np.allclose(continuation_seed(), target)

case_name = 'boundary: lower Table II anchor'
assert np.allclose(continuation_seed(d=200), target)

case_name = 'edge: upper Table II anchor'
assert np.allclose(continuation_seed(d=300), target)

case_name = 'normal: d=250 multistart roots'
assert np.allclose(candidate_roots(), target)

case_name = 'boundary: d=220 local continuation search'
assert np.allclose(candidate_roots(d=220), target)

case_name = 'edge: d=300 upper-anchor search'
assert np.allclose(candidate_roots(d=300), target)

case_name = 'normal: select d=250 continued branch'
assert np.allclose(select_va_branch(), target)

case_name = 'boundary: select d=240 continued branch'
assert np.allclose(select_va_branch(d=240), target)

case_name = 'edge: select upper-anchor branch'
assert np.allclose(select_va_branch(d=300), target)

case_name = 'normal: final d=250 challenge scalar'
assert np.allclose(final_answer(), target)

case_name = 'nearby: final d=240 scalar'
assert np.allclose(final_answer(d=240), target)

case_name = 'edge: final d=300 scalar'
assert np.allclose(final_answer(d=300), target)
